wheelchair_availability: Manual wheelchairs are available at the main entry point for senior citizens and differently-abled pilgrims.
priority_darshan: Senior citizens are given priority entry during regular non-peak hours at the queue counters.
ramps_and_lifts: Partial Access.Temple choultries and TG Tourism Haritha Hotel provide ground-floor room allotments upon request to avoid climbing stairs. Covered seating areas (resting benches) and drinking water points are placed along the main queue lines for comfort.
guidelines: Devotees can request manual wheelchairs at the entry point and ground-floor room allotments to assist with mobility.
